reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:141-143, checkIfIsAvailable computes both start and end from slotStartTime instead of using slotEndTime (defined at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:99). Because end equals start, a slot starting within working hours whose end time exceeds workingHour.endTime is not rejected by the end > workingHour.endTime check.
